name: Heavy Duty Khaki Natural Sisal Cat Scratching Mat Area Rug (1m x 2m)
description: Save your furniture and satisfy your kitty's natural instincts with this extra-large natural sisal cat scratching mat! Measuring a generous 1m x 2m (approx. 3.3ft x 6.6ft), it is perfect for lining long hallways, entryways, or placing underneath high-traffic furniture zones. Made of premium woven eco-friendly faux sisal fiber that is extremely durable, anti-fraying, and doesn't shed messy flakes like generic cardboard scratchers. It features a non-slip textured latex backing to keep it stable on carpets, hardwood, or tile floors. Note: This item is pre-owned but in excellent, fully intact structural shape. Thoroughly vacuumed and sanitized before listing. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a resident cat, it does NOT come with an additional retail storage bag. Local pickup buyers should bring their own bag or hamper for easy transport.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and ready to lay flat. Does NOT come with an additional storage bag; please bring your own hamper or bag for pickup. Thoroughly sanitized, but comes from a pet-friendly student home with a cat.
meta_description: Shop the pre-owned khaki natural sisal cat scratching mat area rug. 1m x 2m large anti-scratch carpet runner with non-slip backing, perfect for pet homes.
name_zh: 卡其色加厚防猫抓仿剑麻猫爪地毯 (1米*2米 走廊长条型)
description_zh: 主子磨爪刚需神器！低价转让自用巨无霸大号仿剑麻猫爪地毯垫子。尺寸为 1米*2米（约3.3英尺*6.6英尺），特别适合铺在玄关、过道或紧贴沙发边缘，能完美保护家里的实木地板与高档家具不受猫爪摧残。采用高密度优质密织纤维，极度耐磨、耐抓且完全不掉屑，比传统的纸板猫抓板寿命长出数倍，且极易打理。背面带有密集的防滑防静电乳胶底，抓地牢固、不卷边移位。地毯已完成深层双向吸尘与全方位消毒擦拭。由于本人养猫，虽然上架前已经过彻底清洁，但织物类难免残留轻微气味。请注意，本品不含零售便携收纳袋，同城自提的小伙伴请务必自行携带打包带或脏衣篮哦！
